toolchain.note: scripts/ci/build-linux.sh runs cargo inside the digest-pinned image

notes: Verified bit-for-bit vs the published v8.3.2 x86_64 release binary. Everything is frozen by the Docker image digest (rustc 1.99.0, gcc 13.3.0, LLD) plus a fixed in-container workdir /lighthouse and CARGO_HOME. No SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH needed; nothing in the dep graph bakes a wall-clock value. Caveat: the image installs cmake/clang via apt at build time, so re-pin if the bookworm gcc/clang moves.
